This folder vendors a prebuilt, unmodified FFmpeg (ffmpeg.exe, ffprobe.exe) so the
app does not depend on a system install. Supercut Extended calls these two binaries
as separate subprocesses (command-line arguments + stdout/stderr) -- it does not link
against libavcodec/libavformat/etc. Supercut Extended itself remains MIT-licensed
(see the repository's own LICENSE); only these two vendored executables are GPLv3.

Build used
----------
ffmpeg-8.1.2-essentials_build, built by gyan.dev (https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/)
Downloaded from: https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/tag/8.1.2
License: GPLv3 (full text in LICENSE-FFmpeg-GPLv3.txt, copied unmodified from the
release archive)

Corresponding source (GPLv3 SS6)
---------------------------------
FFmpeg source at the commit this build was made from:
  https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/38b88335f9
Build scripts/toolchain used to produce this specific Windows build:
  https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg

Filenames are unmodified (ffmpeg.exe / ffprobe.exe). To refetch this exact build,
run `python tools/fetch_ffmpeg.py`.
